options: a student with no revision scores 3.5
each extra hour of revision adds about 3.5 marks
questions.why: The gradient is the increase in y for each extra unit of x, in context.

questions.q: Ice-cream sales and sunburn cases show strong positive correlation. Does eating ice cream cause sunburn? Explain.
questions.model: No. Correlation does not show causation; both are likely caused by a third factor, such as hot sunny weather.
